proposedContributions.change: Define request/result/error schemas for Query, Condition, DomainCommand and Event. Use existing EntityRef/sourceBinding/fieldId and prerequisite AST/value/query/DomainReceipt contracts; freeze node/schema versions and source schema revision/hash. Typed mapping references stable fieldId, source node/output path and target port, never display label. Carry registered commandId, expectedRevision policy and stable logical operation identity. Discriminate validation/conflict/denied/deleted/offlineUnsupported/missingDependency/rateLimited/unknownFormat. Keep simulation result distinct from a durable native command receipt. Diagnostic identifies node/port/field and actionable error without leaking denied metadata. Actor/workspace authorization is transport-derived, not caller actor/owner fields. Names here are proposed, not existing exports.

Contribute four families to the prerequisite existing registry/runtime, not a new builder: Event resolves registered alias/sourceRef and scoped envelope from WP-040; Query delegates bounded actor-safe snapshot/cursor execution to WP-010; Condition delegates bounded typed AST to WP-013 and distinguishes null/missing/invalid/denied; DomainCommand delegates same registered WP-033/native UI/MCP validator/gateway. Resolve schema/field IDs on validate/publish; rename remains valid, removal invalidates config. Every attempt uses current workflow least-scope principal. Dry-run has no dispatch/effect capability and labels all simulated outputs. Publish freezes versions; source schema event marks draft stale rather than mutating a running version.

Implement RA-03 schema-backed inspector/registry picker on the existing selected node and graph draft: source/version/field-ID mapping selection, typed Input/Output/Error and native command expectedRevision policy, permitted preview, inline node/port diagnostics, missing source/scope unavailable state, removed-field publish block. Use t() and existing theme/font controls, no skin reset; hover/focus/click help, keyboard/IME, reduced-motion and narrow/zoom support. Render simulation stamp; no command invoked by selection, help or preview. Preserve invalid/conflicting draft for correction.

Behavior tests for four registered families using accepted domain/query/runtime contracts; Query owner/viewer isolation and bounded cursor; typed Condition null vs denied; field-ID rename and removal; result/error conformance across UI/agent/workflow; malformed args/versions/ports; authenticated actor spoof rejection; dry-run zero effects; duplicate event/command replay and crash/recovery; revoked principal after resume. Seed label-mapping and owner-wide-query mutations and assert their named semantic failures, not source strings or wiring. Runtime/native/restart evidence remains separate from unit fixtures.

Use discovered supported real Electron runner to interact with the existing workspace constructor and RA-03. Exercise actual fields/ports/publish errors/simulation labels, persisted reload and source-schema changes; pointer, keyboard, IME/focus restoration, Russian/all-locale parity, theme, actual Rox Mono, reduced motion and 200% zoom. Do not substitute standalone component fixtures or invented passing runner commands.
